verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents opening new business and personal bank accounts programmatically through an application flow, so per-customer account provisioning is directly supported. The evidence never mentions issuing account or routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, collection accounts, or sub-accounts under a master structure. missing for 10: explicit account/routing number issuance, virtual accounts for reconciliation, sub-accounts under a master/FBO structure, evidence of at-scale provisioning, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue unique account and routing numbers at scale — virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, and sub-accounts under a master structure

citations.quote: To apply to open a new bank account 1. Create a Person Application 2. Create a Business Application
This guide will cover the basics of applying to open new bank accounts (both business and personal) as well as funding those accounts with an initial deposit.
